title: deaddrop: with_clock config-validation error typed as Error::Encode
description: deaddrop.rs:840-845 rejects storage_limit==0 with Error::Encode(storage_limit must be a positive integer) - a config-validation failure reported as encode failure, misleading and inconsistent with Decode/Encode semantics used everywhere else. Fix: dedicated variant or documented convention.
close_reason: Added a dedicated Error::Config(String) variant to the lichen-client error enum ('configuration error: {m}' Display) and retyped with_clock's storage_limit==0 rejection from Error::Encode to Error::Config, consistent with the crate's Decode/Encode wire-error semantics (config validation is neither). Chose dedicated variant over documented convention because the bead itself calls Encode 'misleading'; grep-verified no exhaustive Error matches exist outside the crate, so the addition is non-breaking. with_clock doc updated. New test zero_storage_limit_is_a_config_error pins the variant and Display message. Verified: cargo test -p lichen-client --lib 130 passed, deaddrop_vectors 26 passed. Commit + bd flat files.
